name: 产品展示 15 秒 / Product showcase
use_when: One physical product, one clear benefit.
questions: What is the one benefit to remember?
What should the viewer do (order, WhatsApp, visit)?

beats.visual: The most striking close-up of the product in motion (pour, splash, reveal). No text-heavy shot.
beats.text: A 3-5 word question or bold claim

beats.visual: The moment the customer needs it (tired morning, messy desk).
Hero shot: product centred, clean background, slow push-in.
Someone enjoying or using it; a real-looking result.
beats.text: One proof point the owner supplied (optional)

beats.visual: Product with brand colours, room for text.
beats.text: The call to action from the brand kit
